facts.label: Covered events
facts.text: Nationwide describes protection against covered theft, fire, liability lawsuits and weather losses. The policy determines what is covered.

facts.label: Brand New Belongings
facts.text: This optional feature can repair or replace covered possessions. It has exclusions and limits, varies by state and policy, and is subject to underwriting approval.

facts.label: Price comparison
facts.text: The product page offers home and bundling quotes. Obtain comparable limits, deductibles and optional features before comparing premiums.
